facts.text: The image is a multi-panel character reference sheet with eight labeled panels: a large HERO scene at top, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK full-body views in the middle row, and FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS detail panels along the bottom.

The large HERO panel shows a person standing on a wet paved street at night in rain, wearing a black tactical jacket, black shirt, black trousers, and black boots; metal railings, dark buildings, lit windows, and streetlights are visible behind them.
In the HERO panel the person stands upright with feet apart, arms at their sides, and their head turned toward the viewer's left.
The FRONT panel is a full-body frontal studio view of the same person against a dark gray backdrop, standing with arms down and a neutral expression.
The SIDE PROFILE panel shows the person in a left-facing full-body profile, with short shaved-side hair and a small topknot or bun at the back of the head.
The BACK panel shows a full-body rear view of the person in the black jacket and trousers, standing on the dark studio backdrop.
The FACE panel is a close-up of the person's face showing short shaved-side hair, a small topknot, and a visible scar-like line through one eyebrow.
The JACKET COLLAR panel is a close-up of a black jacket collar with a strap and metal buckle or clasp.
The HANDS panel is a close-up of two weathered hands with visible grime and slightly curled fingers.
The BOOTS panel is a close-up of black leather lace-up combat boots with worn, scuffed surfaces.
The visible panel labels read: HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, BOOTS.
The overall palette is dominated by black and charcoal gray, with cool blue-white lighting and warm amber practical lights in the rainy street scene.

limitations: The image is a composite reference sheet, so fine details such as the exact side of the eyebrow scar and fabric texture are limited by resolution.
Exact identity and backstory are not visually verifiable.
